title: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models via Group Preference Reward Shaping
authors_zh: Huaisheng Zhu, Siyuan Xu, Hangfan Zhang, Teng Xiao, Zhimeng Guo, Shijie Zhou, Shuyue Hu, Vasant G. Honavar
paper_type_zh: 污染、验证器、奖励或评测可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理数据与自动评测可靠性的研究者。
one_line: GPRS replaces raw reward optimization with within-group preference shaping to reduce reward-model sensitivity.
以组内偏好塑形替代原始分数优化，降低无 critic RLHF 对奖励模型质量的敏感性。
why: It exposes how the form of a reward signal can affect post-training stability and downstream alignment claims.
inclusion_reason: Reward-shaping method for auditing robustness to noisy preference reward models.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Critic-free RL methods reduce PPO's memory and compute cost, but GRPO can be unstable when its reward model supplies noisy numeric scores. This is especially problematic for RLHF, where humans can often compare outputs more reliably than assign absolute rewards.

GPRS reframes the optimization signal as a within-group preference comparison. It aims to preserve critic-free training while making reward shaping less sensitive to reward-model size and quality in preference alignment and reasoning tasks.

无 critic 的 RL 方法能降低 PPO 的显存和计算成本，但 GRPO 在奖励模型给出带噪数值分数时可能不稳定。RLHF 中人类通常更可靠地比较多个输出，而非为单个输出给出精确绝对分数，因此该问题尤其突出。

GPRS 将优化信号改写为组内偏好比较，目标是在保留无 critic 训练的同时，降低偏好对齐和推理任务对奖励模型规模、质量的敏感性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: GPRS samples a group of policy responses, ranks or compares their reward-model outputs, and shapes each response's training reward from its preference relation within the group instead of treating the raw score as exact. The feedback object is a relative ordering, aligned with pairwise preference supervision; no extra critic or value model is required. It is a training method, not a released dataset: the official paper reports RLHF and reasoning experiments with varied reward-model sizes to test robustness.
GPRS 为同一提示采样一组策略响应，排序或比较其奖励模型输出，并依据响应在组内的偏好关系塑形训练奖励，而非把原始分数当作精确值。反馈对象是相对排序，与成对偏好监督一致；不需要额外 critic 或 value model。它是训练方法而非公开数据集：官方论文在不同奖励模型规模下报告 RLHF 和推理实验以检验鲁棒性。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Sample multiple completions from the old policy used for the current training batch, for each prompt.
  1. Obtain reward-model scores, but use them only to establish preference comparisons among completions.
  1. Shape each completion's reward by its within-group preference relation, then optimize the policy with a KL-regularized critic-free objective.
  1. Compare GPRS with GRPO and Reinforce++ on RLHF and reasoning, varying reward-model size. The check is stable win rate or task performance under weaker reward models; verify exact group size, KL settings, datasets, and sampling parameters from the release.

1. 对每个提示从当前训练批次的旧策略采样多个完成。
  1. 获得奖励模型分数，但仅用它建立完成之间的偏好比较。
  1. 按组内偏好关系塑形每个完成的奖励，再以带 KL 约束的无 critic 目标优化策略。
  1. 在 RLHF、推理上比较 GPRS、GRPO、Reinforce++，并改变奖励模型规模。检查项是在较弱奖励模型下是否维持稳定胜率或任务表现；复现须核对组大小、KL 设置、数据集和采样参数。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim: preference shaping is more robust than score normalization when reward quality varies. Using Pythia-2.8B with reward models from 410M to 6.9B, Figure 1 compares GPRS, GRPO, and Reinforce++ on Anthropic-HH and shows GPRS maintains the strongest win rate across the reported sizes. The paper additionally evaluates RLHF and reasoning tasks, where GPRS consistently beats other critic-free algorithms or is comparable to group normalization. This evidence supports reduced sensitivity in these experimental recipes, not immunity to reward misspecification or reward hacking.

核心主张是奖励质量变化时，偏好塑形比按分数归一化更稳健。图1以 Pythia-2.8B 和 410M 至 6.9B 奖励模型，在 Anthropic-HH 上比较 GPRS、GRPO、Reinforce++，显示 GPRS 在报告的各规模上保持最高胜率。论文还在 RLHF、推理任务中评测，GPRS 持续优于其他无 critic 算法或与组归一化相当。该证据支持这些配方下敏感性降低，不能证明它免受奖励错设或奖励投机影响。

title: Novelty
新意
html: PPO uses a critic and raw rewards, while GRPO removes the critic but normalizes scores within a group. GPRS changes the optimization signal itself: it converts reward-model scores into within-group preference relations before shaping policy rewards. That is closer to the pairwise supervision used to train RLHF reward models and targets instability caused by interpreting noisy scores as cardinal values. It does not replace the reward model, provide a verifier, or establish that pairwise comparisons are faithful in every domain.
PPO 使用 critic 和原始奖励，GRPO 去掉 critic 但在组内归一化分数。GPRS 改变的是优化信号本身：先把奖励模型分数转换为组内偏好关系，再塑形策略奖励。这更接近 RLHF 奖励模型的成对监督，并针对把噪声分数解释为基数值所致的不稳定。它并未替代奖励模型、提供 verifier，也未证明成对比较在所有领域都忠实。

title: Limitations
局限
html: GPRS still derives comparisons from a learned reward model; systematic preference bias can therefore be preserved even when optimization becomes less sensitive to its scale. Within-group rankings also depend on sampled candidates, group size, and prompt distribution, so a stable win rate need not prove safe behavior outside the test sets. Before reuse, audit reward-model pairwise errors and compare against a held-out human or task verifier rather than relying on the shaped reward alone.
GPRS 仍从学习到的奖励模型导出比较，因此即使优化对规模较不敏感，系统性偏好偏差仍会保留。组内排序还取决于候选采样、组大小和提示分布，稳定胜率不等于在测试集外安全。复用前应审计奖励模型的成对错误，并用留出的人类评估或任务 verifier 比较，不能只依赖塑形奖励。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: An RLHF practitioner with a preference reward model can replace raw-score group normalization with GPRS, then compare win rate and reward-model sensitivity under a fixed policy, prompts, and compute budget. The output is a critic-free post-training run and an audit of how reward-model size changes outcomes. It is most useful when pairwise preferences are more credible than absolute scores. Do not use it when a reliable task-specific verifier exists and no preference model is needed, or when group rankings have not been independently audited.
拥有偏好奖励模型的 RLHF 实践者可用 GPRS 替换原始分数组归一化，并在固定策略、提示和计算预算下比较胜率及对奖励模型规模的敏感性。输出是无 critic 后训练运行和奖励规模如何改变结果的审计。当成对偏好比绝对分数更可信时最适用；若已有可靠任务 verifier 而不需偏好模型，或组内排序未独立审计，则不应采用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: GPRS stabilizes critic-free RLHF by shaping group preferences rather than optimizing raw reward scores.
  • Mechanism: sample a response group, infer within-group preferences, and use them as policy rewards.
  • Artifact: the official EMNLP 2025 paper is available; no official downloadable dataset or code was confirmed.
  • Evidence anchor: Pythia-2.8B experiments across 410M–6.9B reward models favor GPRS in Figure 1.
  • Reuse decision: audit the pairwise reward signal before adopting it; it reduces score sensitivity but cannot repair biased preferences.

• 定位：GPRS 以组偏好塑形而非优化原始分数，稳定无 critic RLHF。
  • 方法抓手：采样响应组，推断组内偏好，并将其作为策略奖励。
  • 数据与材料：官方 EMNLP 2025 论文可得；未确认官方可下载数据集或代码。
  • 证据锚点：图1中 Pythia-2.8B 在 410M–6.9B 奖励模型下支持 GPRS。
  • 复用决定：采用前审计成对奖励信号；它降低分数敏感性，不能修复偏好偏差。
